title: Onboard token-stream contract and template graceful-degradation
creator: Maya Chen
description: When new model bundles are onboarded and pinned we sometimes observe template mismatch errors or subtle tokenization regressions that invalidate published performance profiles. This ticket defines the token-stream contract, implements a lightweight runtime shim for graceful template degradation during onboarding, and adds verification gates so published profiles are not silently corrupted. Goal: prevent profile publish/rollout due to tokenizer/template edge cases and provide clear rollback paths.
acceptance_criteria: Define a short token-stream contract document that enumerates role delimiter expectations, allowed zero-width characters, and emoji/ZWJ handling for supported model families
Implement runtime shim that normalizes incoming chat templates to the contract without changing semantic role ordering (shim enabled by default during onboarding rollouts)
Add automatic profile publish blockers if tokenizer fingerprint or template normalization statistics deviate beyond thresholds
Create end-to-end tests that run new model bundles through the onboarding harness using a fixed suite of chat templates and assert token-level equivalence after normalization
Instrument telemetry dashboards showing normalized token deltas and rolling failure rates for onboarding models
comments: 2025-02-10 Maya Chen: Initial discovery — observed 3 onboarding failures last week where performance profile publish succeeded but downstream generation latency/regression tests started failing. Root cause points to tokenization delta for system role markers and ZWJ sequences.

2025-02-12 Rafael Ortiz: Spike completed. Built prototype normalizer that strips/normalizes zero-width joiners and coerces role delimiters to canonical forms. Prototype passes 84% of templates in the harness; failing cases are documents with mixed legacy markers (e.g., '<<SYS>>' + '

').
2025-02-14 Design review (Anika Patel): UX note — console should surface a clear warning when a pinned model requires template normalization. Suggested copy and severity levels for the rollout page.

2025-02-16 Engineering: Added gating to profile publisher — if median token delta per template > 3 tokens or if fraction of templates that changed > 10%, block publish and surface diff artifacts in the onboarding run

2025-02-18 QA: Created e2e harness cases including emoji clusters and mixed whitespace. Found a corner where combined pre-tokenizer and post-normalizer reduced token count causing kv-cache misalignment for long context. Rafa is investigating KV cache mitigation.

2025-02-20 Rafael Ortiz: KV cache mitigation implemented by emitting a stable prefix checksum and ensuring cached entries are evicted if normalization changes checksum. This is preserved behind a feature flag for rollout testing.
2025-02-22 Ops: Dashboard PR opened to add 'Normalizers vs Tokens' chart to onboarding dashboard. Linked to run 2025-02-21-ONB-003 for visual example.

2025-02-24 PM (Liam Brooks): Prioritization approved for P1. Requested a short runbook for oncall in case the publish blocker triggers unexpectedly in the next two weeks of ramping onboarding traffic.
2025-02-25 Rafael Ortiz: Preparing PR with unit tests + e2e. Next: schedule canary with feature flag enabled for 10% of onboarding runs and monitor token delta telemetry.
